slides.title: Win back the members who [[stopped coming]].
slides.sub:
You import your member list, once. casdey works out who has lapsed, writes to each of them in your gym's name, follows up when they go quiet, answers the replies and books them back in.

Your only job is the import.

posts.caption:
Every gym has them: the members who quietly stopped showing up and then stopped paying. Most never get asked to come back, because nobody has the time to write to two hundred people one at a time.

That's the whole job casdey does, in your gym's name, not ours.

#gymowner #fitnessbusiness #memberretention #gymsoftware
